value.evidence: Draft A grounds the post in concrete facts from the brief: specific model counts (7 models, 6 open-weight + 1 closed), exact tree parameters (400 people, 10 generations, ~18k tokens), test volume (200 questions), testing conditions (OpenRouter, 8k max tokens, temperature 0.3), and actual results (Gemini 2.5 Pro 81.48%, GLM 4.5 64.02%). It explicitly flags limitations (new benchmark, potentially suboptimal parameters, no-response rate as token-limit indicator) and closes with actionable community questions about improving performance and benchmark evolution. Draft B uses only F1 and F2, omitting all quantitative results, testing parameters, and performance data. It pivots to speculative questions about synthetic vs. real-world data and generalization—topics not grounded in the provided facts and outside the brief's scope (which centers on FamilyBench's methodology and initial findings, not philosophical debates about synthetic benchmarks). Draft B's framing as 'how effective do you think' invites opinion rather than discussion of documented results. For a local LLM enthusiast audience seeking to understand FamilyBench's actual performance and design, Draft A preserves the evidence needed for informed discussion; Draft B discards it in favor of untethered speculation.

Draft A opens with a genuine question about synthetic vs. real-world validity and invites community perspective on generalization risks—strong community fit. Draft B provides concrete specificity: exact model count (7), tree scale (400 people, 10 generations, ~18k tokens), question volume (200), testing parameters (8k max tokens, temperature 0.3), and actual accuracy figures (Gemini 2.5 Pro 81.48%, GLM 4.5 64.02%). It acknowledges essential limitations (new benchmark, suboptimal parameters, no-response rate definition) and closes with actionable questions about fine-tuning and prompting strategies. Draft B directly addresses the brief's core goal—'discuss the effectiveness...and understand implications of initial benchmark results'—while A sidesteps the results to pose a methodological critique. For a local LLM enthusiast audience seeking to understand current performance and next steps, B's grounded evidence and parameter transparency outweigh A's more open-ended framing. Both avoid forbidden claims, but B's specificity and information density make it more useful to the stated audience and purpose.
